Identity.History: The Huns were a powerful nomadic confederation that entered Europe from the Eurasian steppe in the late 4th century AD. Their fast-moving cavalry armies disrupted Germanic peoples and pressured both halves of the Roman Empire. Under Attila in the 5th century, they built a vast but short-lived empire stretching across central and eastern Europe. After Attila’s death, Hunnic power quickly fragmented.
